name: agent-skills
description: Londopy's agent skills: the rollcall family as one plugin, or each one on its own. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, OpenCode.

plugins.name: londopy-skills
plugins.description: All four at once: skill-rollcall, mcp-rollcall, settings-effective, git-attribution.

plugins.name: skill-rollcall
plugins.description: Which skills are registered, which are new, which will never register and why - in any Agent Skills host.

plugins.name: mcp-rollcall
plugins.description: Which MCP servers will fail to connect, exactly why, and what each costs - Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, Copilot, VS Code, Windsurf, OpenCode.

plugins.name: settings-effective
plugins.description: The merged Claude Code settings actually in effect, which file decided each key, and why yours isn't applying. Runs from any host.

plugins.name: git-attribution
plugins.description: Find and remove AI co-author attribution (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor, Gemini, ...) from git history; guard against it coming back.
